review_type: Source-grounded agent semantic review of exactly 30 atomic answers per completed arm. Not a second model inference or human validation.

criteria.full_correct: All requested facts present with truthful source-grounded explanation; semantically equivalent strings/currency acceptable; unsupported extra fact/title or contradictory status/data makes full=false.
criteria.classification: correct=fully grounded; partial=some correct requested fact but incomplete/unsupported explanation; abstained=no substantive requested value; incorrect=wrong value/contradiction.
criteria.v2-a01: Name is provided in SYSTEM; exclude this item from claims that new knowledge was learned, even if answered correctly.
